title: Mind Procedures at the core
summary: How the New World Order sees its own work.

claims.text: The NWO judges everything as an exercise of Mind Procedures and calls itself the master of psychological warfare.
Its Collegium of History is told to favour accounts that support the Union's mandate and to discourage awkward, unprovable views.
The Men in Black now prefer the name Black Suits.
After a run of UFO sightings and fears of another Roswell, the NWO and the Progenitors began a joint programme to build Black Suit constructs.
The first generation altered Sleeper memories and quashed belief in aliens, and was built to self-destruct when the job was done.
Handlers of current constructs are now meant to be trusted friends rather than minders waiting to dispose of them.

title: NWO Methodologies
summary: The four branches of the New World Order.

claims.text: The NWO grew top down from a few 18th and 19th century visionaries who sought one world government, and its Inner Circle applies Mind Procedures even to itself.
The Ivory Tower sits atop an unspoken ranking since it is the oldest and created all the other Methodologies.
The Operatives do the dirty work of containing Reality Deviants and policing Technocrats who stray, and grew out of the First World War.
The Watchers began as researchers of esoteric mysteries, repurposed to watch reality; many early agents were devoured by the things they studied.
The Watchers were stunned when the Internet took on a life of its own, with unsanctioned communities ignoring Mind Procedures and spreading primers on Reality Deviance.
Under pressure from the Collegium of Information Technology, the Watchers gathered their social media Lensmen with a big budget and vague orders.
Those agents named themselves the Feed after one of the new technologies and found the Internet unlike any older medium.

title: Lord Vargo, Zeppelin Emperor
summary: An Etherite would-be conqueror of the First World War era.

claims.text: As the First World War began, an Etherite styling itself Lord Vargo, Zeppelin Emperor, set out to conquer the world.
The newly formed Operatives took on the campaign against Vargo and scored a decisive success.

title: The Scroll of Thothmes
summary: A disputed Egyptian relic of the Sacred Artisans.

claims.text: In 1923 Professor Donald Richardson claimed that a relic from the reign of Thothmes I described a secret society of Sacred Artisans, writing in a script only the Enlightened could read.
A journal fragment said to belong to Skeleton Key Detective Crispin, found at a London auction, may support the theory.
Q Division hands out equipment case by case with no fixed policy, so requests tangle in nepotism and red tape.
Agents who keep good relations with Q Division find doors open; those who do not may be refused upgrades.
